subject: numpy
why: numpy 2.5.3's licence expression is BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0; Zlib (permissive, not copyleft) is not on the ADR-0176 list. numpy is a hard dependency of modelscan (its pickle scanner imports it).

subject: numpy.libs/libgfortran
why: the GCC Fortran runtime bundled in numpy's manylinux wheel (for OpenBLAS). The GCC Runtime Library Exception lets independent code link it without GPL obligations; ADR-0176 bars GPL in shipped code, so the owner decides (R10 Consequences for B5-M 7). The alternative is building numpy without it.

subject: numpy.libs/libquadmath
why: the GCC quad-precision runtime bundled in numpy's manylinux wheel. Shipped unmodified as a separate shared library; LGPL is outside ADR-0176's list, so the owner decides.

subject: h5py.libs/libhdf5
why: the HDF5 library bundled in h5py's wheel, under the HDF Group's own BSD-style licence (h5py licenses/hdf5.txt), which has no SPDX id on the ADR-0176 list.

subject: h5py.libs/libhdf5_hl
why: HDF5's high-level library, bundled with libhdf5 under the same licence.

subject: python
why: the CPython runtime of the base image (permissive, not copyleft), which modelscan needs to run; PSF-2.0 is not on the ADR-0176 list.
